name: Public utilities administration
description: Water/energy/gas/internet: providers, due dates, consumption, budget vs actual, split bills.
functional_summary: Water/energy/gas/internet: providers, due dates, consumption, budget vs actual, split bills.

user_stories.i_want: track water/energy/gas/internet consumption and due dates
user_stories.so_that: I never miss a bill and can budget

acceptance.criterion: Utility CRUD by type with provider, account, dueDay, budget

design.layout: [Tabs: Water | Energy | Gas | Internet] / [Cards: provider, account, dueDay, budget, StatusBadge next-due] / [Consumption chart + Add reading]
components: @swal/ui: Tabs, Card, Table, Input, Button, StatusBadge, Toaster
flow: Register utility → log monthly reading → chart budget vs actual → due-date reminder toast → optional split bill per tenant

acceptance.criterion: Utility CRUD by type with provider, account, dueDay, budget
